pdf_13_14_switch_behavior.heading: SPINNER
pdf_13_14_switch_behavior.text: Scores 100 points or 500 points for each spinner light lit.

pdf_13_14_switch_behavior.heading: SPINNER LANE GATE
pdf_13_14_switch_behavior.text: Scores 1,000 points and collects Extra Ball when lit and Special when lit. Extra Ball lights with 4X and Special lights with 5X. Completing a color in the Square increases the Bonus Multiplier (max. 5X).

pdf_13_14_switch_behavior.heading: LEFT FLIPPER BUTTON
pdf_13_14_switch_behavior.text: Stops the Drop Target bank lights on desired color for Backbox Playfield feature.

pdf_13_14_switch_behavior.heading: TOP & BOTTOM THUMPER BUMPER
pdf_13_14_switch_behavior.text: Scores 1,000 points and alternates return lane Extra Ball lights, out lane Special lights and switch 25, 26 and 27 lights.

pdf_13_14_switch_behavior.heading: TOP, LEFT & RIGHT SLINGSHOTS
pdf_13_14_switch_behavior.text: Scores 10 points and alternates return lane Extra Ball lights, out lane Special lights and switch 25, 26 and 27 lights.

pdf_13_14_switch_behavior.heading: DROP TARGET SET "A" & BACKBOX "A" ROLLOVERS
pdf_13_14_switch_behavior.text: Each target and rollover scores 1,000 points. All targets down or making "A" lane in Backbox spots lit number on Bank "A" in the Square.

pdf_13_14_switch_behavior.heading: OUTHOLE REFLEX
pdf_13_14_switch_behavior.text: When closed will advance the ball to the outhole runway switches.

pdf_13_14_switch_behavior.heading: LEFT & RIGHT OUT LANE
pdf_13_14_switch_behavior.text: Scores 5,000 points and Special when lit. Lights with 5X. (Only one out lane Special lit at a time â€” alternate.)

pdf_13_14_switch_behavior.heading: LEFT & RIGHT RETURN LANE
pdf_13_14_switch_behavior.text: Scores 1,000 points and awards Extra Ball when lit. Lights by making A, B, C and D banks in order (all targets down when letter is lit.) (Only one return lane Extra Ball light lit at a time).

pdf_13_14_switch_behavior.heading: DROP TARGET SET "B" & BACKBOX "B" ROLLOVERS
pdf_13_14_switch_behavior.text: Each target and rollover scores 1,000 points. All targets down or making "B" lane in Backbox spots lit number on Bank "B" in the Square.

pdf_13_14_switch_behavior.heading: SPOT 6 ROLLOVER WIRE
pdf_13_14_switch_behavior.text: Scores 1,000 points and stops the Drop Target bank lights on Red. (If, on a particular bank, red has already been made, then the lights on that bank will continue to rotate.) Scores 5,000 points and spots No. 6 in the Square when lit.

pdf_13_14_switch_behavior.heading: SPOT 1 ROLLOVER WIRE
pdf_13_14_switch_behavior.text: Same as Sw. No. 25 but stops lights on Amber and spots No. 1 in Square when lit.

pdf_13_14_switch_behavior.heading: SPOT 2 STAND-UP TARGET
pdf_13_14_switch_behavior.text: Scores 1,000 points. Scores 5,000 points and spots No. 2 in the Square when lit.

pdf_13_14_switch_behavior.heading: TOP SWITCH & ROLLOVER BUTTON
pdf_13_14_switch_behavior.text: Scores 10 points and alternates return lane Extra Ball lights, out lane specials, and switch 25, 26 and 27 lights.

pdf_13_14_switch_behavior.heading: TOP RIGHT ROLLOVER WIRE
pdf_13_14_switch_behavior.text: Scores 1,000 points and increases the spinner value (lights spinner lamps).

pdf_13_14_switch_behavior.heading: DROP TARGET SET "C" & BACKBOX "C" ROLLOVERS
pdf_13_14_switch_behavior.text: Each target and rollover scores 1,000 points. All targets down or making "C" lane in Backbox spots lit number on Bank "C" in the Square.

pdf_13_14_switch_behavior.heading: LEFT & RIGHT KICKOUT HOLES
pdf_13_14_switch_behavior.text: Scores 7,000 points and releases ball when any color in the Square is completed. If a color in the Square is completed in the Backbox Playfield feature, the ball is released on next turn.

pdf_13_14_switch_behavior.heading: DROP TARGET SET "D" & BACKBOX "D" ROLLOVERS
pdf_13_14_switch_behavior.text: Each target and rollover scores 1,000 points. All targets down or making "D" lane in Backbox spots lit number on Bank "D" in the Square.

script_lines.text: vpmMapLights AllLamps 		'Make a collection called "AllLamps" and put all the light objects in it.
